selection: Frozen identity packets classified structurally into exactly one record versus at least two records.
registration_timing: Supplement requested after inspecting the completed all-ID paired comparison; structural criterion uses only input record counts.
purpose: Multi-record IDs can test consistency across citations assigned to an ID; singleton IDs cannot.
interpretation: Paired model agreement on identical frozen bibliographic evidence; neither reviewer is a truth reference. No human accuracy, error-rate, causal anchoring effect, or model-winner inference.
